verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's homepage claims you can 'manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack', and Incident Workflows provide automated if-this-then-that responses. However, nothing in the pack documents declaring an incident from chat, or the automatic creation of channels, roles, or updates. The Slack Post-Incident Review entry point applies only after an incident is resolved. Missing for 10: documented incident declaration from Slack, Microsoft Teams support, automatic incident channel creation, role assignment from chat, automated status updates in chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can declare and run an incident from chat — Slack or Teams — with channels, roles, and updates created for me

citations.quote: Manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack or your IDE.
Incident Workflows allow you to build an automated response for every incident.
